title: Phase 2 Data Layer Comparison
subtitle: Guadalupe Cypress max stack: real color plus vegetation/canopy/point-cloud/terrain signals.

items.label: RGB Orthophoto
items.note: Real aerial color; best for ground texture reference at high altitude.

items.label: NIR False Color
items.note: Near-infrared source, useful for vegetation discrimination.

items.label: Vegetation Signal
items.note: Derived vegetation mask from NIR-style data; not a color texture.

items.label: Point Cloud RGB
items.note: Top-down color from LAZ point clouds; coverage differs from orthophoto.

items.label: Hillshade
items.note: Terrain form layer from DTM; useful for texture baking and QA.
